title: 高盛卡普兰：通胀与AI的拉锯战，美联储面临两难
speaker: Rob Kaplan

segments.en: It's a tension between an infrastructure boom, CapEx AI-related, infrastructure-related data center boom in the US, which is probably inflationary and straining resources and labor.
segments.zh: 美国基础设施繁荣、AI相关资本支出、数据中心繁荣，这可能是通胀性的，并给资源和劳动力带来压力。

segments.en: At the same time over the horizon, we have an AI adoption boom coming, which should be disinflationary.
segments.zh: 同时，未来还有AI应用繁荣，这应该是通缩性的。

segments.en: And we have a war that has been negatively affecting prices that ideally is coming to an end and a straight being reopened.
segments.zh: 还有一场对价格产生负面影响的战争，理想情况下即将结束，海峡重新开放。

segments.en: And so that's kind of the balance that previous Fed shares would have described.
segments.zh: 这就是之前美联储主席会描述的平衡。

segments.en: And I think he's telling us, you're going to have to surmise that he's not going to take you through that debate.
segments.zh: 我认为他在告诉我们，你必须推测他不会带你经历这场辩论。
